unstuck_said.text: Filed issue taskfuel/skills#4: "A Nano (XNO) settle rail for the prepaid balance — feeless per-call spend". Framed in their own terms — Taskfuel is one account for the paid web, prepaid USD balance spent per call; a feeless rail keeps every per-call micro-payment at full value. Proposed Nano as a settle option beside the prepaid USD balance, block hash as the per-call receipt. No machine signature.
